atts.title:
The Card
for the Future
of Money
atts.subtitle: Precision-milled titanium alloy with Secure Element encryption and neural-link fraud detection. A financial instrument engineered to the same standard as the device in your hand.
atts.heading: h1

atts.text: Your card number is never stored on device or Apple servers. Generated per-transaction cryptographic tokens ensure zero-exposure payment architecture.
Every transaction is authorized through the Secure Enclave using biometric hash comparison. Sub-200ms auth with liveness detection at the hardware level.
On-device ML model trained on behavioral patterns catches anomalous transactions before they settle.
The same alloy used in surgical instruments and spacecraft. Laser-etched with no exposed numbers.

steps.title: Biometric Capture
steps.content: 01 Biometric Capture Face ID or Touch ID initiates a cryptographic challenge to the Secure Enclave. Liveness detection prevents spoofing at the hardware level. 189ms

steps.title: Secure Enclave Verification
steps.content: 02 Secure Enclave Verification The T2 chip compares the biometric hash against the enrolled template. No biometric data ever leaves the device or transits the network. 0.3ms

steps.title: Token Generation
steps.content: 03 Token Generation A one-time cryptographic token replaces the card number for each transaction. The actual PAN is never transmitted. AES-256

steps.title: Neural Fraud Analysis
steps.content: 04 Neural Fraud Analysis On-device ML evaluates 12 million behavioral signals in parallel before authorizing. Anomaly detection happens before the network call. 99.97%

steps.title: Real-Time Settlement
steps.content: 05 Real-Time Settlement Approved transactions post to your ledger in 2.1ms. Daily Cash is calculated and applied within the same settlement cycle. 2.1ms

atts.text: Apple never knows what you buy, where you buy it, or how much you pay. Goldman Sachs never receives your purchase data.
Your biometric template is mathematically bound to the Secure Enclave chip. It cannot be extracted or transmitted.
On-device machine learning evaluates transaction context, behavioral patterns and geolocation delta before any network call.
Post-quantum cryptographic key agreement using CRYSTALS-Kyber lattice-based algorithms. Future-proof by design.
Instant push notification with merchant geotag, amount, and fraud confidence score. Every transaction, every time.
Grade 5 aerospace titanium with laser-etched name. No visible card number. No CVV. No expiry date on the surface.
